title: Home
mission:
Our mission

We provide citizens and companies of the Province of Prato with environmental services in the field of wastewater and liquid waste sector.

We offer wastewater recovery and distribution services, we deal with the disposing of most of the purification residues and we provide services at competitive costs.

We carry out our activities respecting the environment and environmental legislation.

items.title: Depuration
items.text: The centralized depuration system consists of a few large plants connected to domestic and industrial users by a sewer network.

items.title: Retrieval
items.text: Gida, being aware of owning the two main sources of "recyclable" water, has acquired a decisive role in the retrieval aimed at reusing wastewater.

items.title: Treatment
items.text: The sewage treatment plant is located inside Calice and Baciacavallo purification plants and has been active since 1992.

ricerca.title: Education and research
ricerca.text: The company's commitment to research, study and experimentation is remarkable. Often the research is carried out in collaboration with external bodies, mainly university institutes, and is aimed at deepening more general and more properly scientific themes. GIDA experiments with new forms of reuse of purified water in the industrial, nursery and landscape sectors
